answer: One enforceable rule: threshold the attestation graph's conductance to flag dense mutual-voting cliques. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The beacon of work and the velvet of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a lagoon to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
